name: DORZOLAMIDE / TIMOLOL 20MG/5MG/1ML SOLUTION 5ML 1 PIECE
description: The combination of dorzolamide 20 mg/ml and timolol 5 mg/ml in ophthalmic solution is a prescription eye drop for the treatment of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is available in a 5 ml bottle. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
